item.text: The provider currently assumes a vault exists during initialization and asks the bridge to create one there. I’m moving vault creation to the alias creation flow, while keeping the drawer’s list and empty state driven by the provider’s fetched aliases.

The bridge and provider changes are in place. I also made the empty state say “No aliases” and changed its action to “Get an alias.” The existing PassAliases tests are running; I’ll use their result to catch any rendering or modal regressions.
